solver_notes: Metadata mismatch disclosed: CPython has no root lockless_queue.c; this is a portable native lock-free stack proof, not a CPython patch. The head is a 16-byte-aligned {pointer, uint64_t epoch} pair. Every successful push/pop CAS increments the 64-bit epoch, so an A->B->A pointer recycle cannot satisfy the stale expected pair. Native AArch64 LDAXP/STLXP instructions implement 128-bit acquire loads and acq/rel CAS; no mutex or libatomic fallback. An initial libatomic version passed logical tests but __atomic_is_lock_free(16)=0, so it was rejected and replaced; disassembly proves the final instructions. The deterministic regression pauses a consumer after reading A/next B, pops A and B, recycles A, then resumes: legacy pointer-only CAS corrupts head to B and loses C, while tagged CAS rejects and preserves C. Tagging prevents ABA head-state corruption; it does not by itself make arbitrary freed-node dereference safe. Tests use stable owned node storage; production reclamation still requires hazard pointers, epochs, or another safe memory-reclamation protocol. Epoch uniqueness is bounded by 2^64 transitions. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
